query: I have an 89-year-old male patient. Among male ICU hospital admissions, what is the IQR of first (index) serum sodium?

This approach is valid in BigQuery and resolves the syntax error. The rest of the query remains unchanged as it correctly identifies the first serum sodium measurement per ICU stay for male patients. The age filter was omitted as the clinical question asks for the IQR among male ICU admissions in general, not specifically for 89-year-olds.;
